title: One-Way Rift
summary: A one-way ANOVA with aov(): set the group order, describe each group, read the F table and pull out F, p and η².
hints: `factor(pd$programme, levels = c("Workshop", "Coaching", "Online"))` sets the order groups appear in.
`fit <- aov(efficacy_t2 ~ programme, data = pd)`, then `tab <- summary(fit)[[1]]` is the ANOVA table as a data frame.
`tab$"F value"[1]` and `tab$"Pr(>F)"[1]`; `eta_squared(fit)` from effectsize gives η².
